court: In the High Court of Madras
case_number: W.P. Crl. No. 503 of 2026 and WPMP. Crl. No. 147 of 2026
advocates: For R 1 to R 4 : Mr. Leonard Arul Joseph Selvam, Additional Public Prosecutor
judgment_text:
PRAYER : Writ Petition is filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of India, to issue an order or direction or writ, more particularly writ in the nature of writ of mandamus, directing the respondents 3 & 4 to permit and provide Police protection to the petitioner and other persons belonging to ‘B’ Party in the consecration function scheduled to be held from 6-3-2026 to 8-3-2026 for Arulmigu Sri. Pulla Muniyappan Temple and Arulmigu Sri. Mariyamman Temple situated at Thimmampatty Colony, M.G.R. Nagar, Palacode Taluk, Dharmapuri District by considering the representation of the petitioner dated 25-2-2026.

The Order of the Court was delivered by

M. Nirmal Kumar, J.:— The petitioner representing Thimmampatty villagers sent a representation dated 25-2-2026 to the 4th respondent to permit them to worship Arulmigu Sri. Pulla Muniyappan Temple and to participate in temple festival which is scheduled to be held from 6-3-2026 to 8-3-2026.

2. The objection of the learned Additional Public Prosecutor is that already a group of villagers joined and conducting temple festival from 6-3-2026 to 8-3-2026 by their own contribution and following certain procedures which should not be disturbed in any manner. If there any law and order problem is created, then the Police would take appropriate action to ensure that the temple festival is conducted in a smooth and peaceful manner. He further submits that the petitioner's plea is not to be discriminated and permit them to worship the god and there can be no objection beyond worshipping and participating in the festival. If there is any intrusion or obstacle, the same will be dealt accordingly as per law.

3. In view of the above, the 4th respondent viz., the Inspector of Police, Palacode Police Station, Dharmapuri to ensure that there is no discrimination in worshipping Arulmigu Sri. Pulla Muniyappan Temple and offering prayers. The festival already fixed and is in progress as per the public notice produced, the same shall proceed without any disturbance or obstruction. In the event of any disturbance, appropriate action can be taken by the 4th respondent Police.

4. In the result, this Writ Petition is disposed of. Consequently, connected miscellaneous petition is closed. No costs.
